articles.title: 200,000 MCP servers expose a command execution flaw that Anthropic calls a feature
articles.summary: Anthropic created the Model Context Protocol as the open standard for AI agent-to-tool communication. OpenAI adopted it in March 2025. Google DeepMind followed.
